the-dragon: Your Reckless Abandon grants you an absorb equal to 10% of your maximum health that lasts for up to 12 seconds. Damage dealt to the shield is reduced by 50%.
the-stag: While Reckless Abandon is active, you gain +30% movement speed and +20% damage reduction.
the-viper: Your Reckless Abandon causes you to heal for 30% of all damage you deal for 8 seconds.

the-wolf: Your Rupture instantly heals you for 25% of your maximum health and grants you 12% Damage Reduction for 12 seconds
the-tower: Your Reckless Abandon duration is increased by 4 seconds.
the-shadow: Your Magic Damage Reduction is increased by 10%.
the-beetle: When you take damage equal to 40% of your max health or more in a single hit, the damage is reduced by 30%. This can only occur once every 20 seconds.

battle-res: Revive: Revive target dead ally. Can be used in combat (5 minute cooldown)
chickenize: Chickenize!: Instantly turn your target into a chicken. Chickenize! can only be used a limited amount of times per dungeon. The charges are shared by everyone in the party. Chickenized enemies do not give Kill Score. Can be used during Global Cooldown (3 minute cooldown)
dispell: Major Dispel: Instantly Dispel all harmful magic effects from you and your allies in a large radius around you. Can be used during Global Cooldown (2 minute cooldown)
group-invisibility: Major Invisibility: Instantly conceal yourself all nearby allies, granting Major Invisiblilty for 15 seconds. Can only be used out of combat. (6 minute cooldown)
health-potion: Rejuvenate: Instantly replenish 40% of your maximum health. Can be used during Global Cooldown (2 minute cooldown)
interrupt-healer: Interject Spell: Interrupt the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect. Can be used during Global Cooldown (1 minute cooldown)
mana-potion: Restore Mana: Instantly restore 30% of your maximum mana. Can be used during Global Cooldown (2 minute cooldown)
move-speed: Bloodrite Fervor: You and nearby allies gain 50% increased Movement Speed for 12 seconds. Can be used during Global Cooldown (1 minute cooldown)
portal: Conjure Portal: Conjures two interactable Portals that you and your allies can use to safely travel between two points. Can only have 1 active portal at a time. (2 minute cooldown)

Each strike from your Earthfist Barrage to a target afflicted by Forbidden Technique adds 1 stack to the effect, up to 50 stacks. Each time Forbidden Technique erupts, all additional stacks are consumed and you are granted 1.2% Damage Reduction for each stack consumed for 18 seconds. You can only have one Forbidden Technique active at any time.

Overcharged Abilities Hold down the relevant ability button until a cast bar is displayed. Once the cast has completed, the overcharged version of the ability will trigger.
The initial heal of your Fluttercall: Restore Life has +50% increased critical strike chance.

Your Shroomsplosion ability can now target allies, sending up to 5 Boomshrooms to detonate on them, instantly healing them for 231% Intellect each. When targeting allies in this way, the Boomshroom still deals its normal damage to nearby enemies.
Each time your Nettlebolt deals damage, you replenish 1% of your maximum Mana.

Your Fluttercall: Heal, Nettlebolt, Prickly Vine, Shroomsplosion, Life Petal, and Heart Bloom casts grant you Every Other Flutter for 8 seconds. Every Other Flutter causes your next cast of Fluttercall: Restore Life to have 25% reduced Mana cost.
Each time your Prickly Vines deal damage, your Life Petal triggers an additional tick of its healing at 25% power. Your Prickly Vines deal 12% more damage for each player that has a Pink Flutterfly.

When your Fluttercall: Heal or Fluttercall: Restore Life heals an ally at 50% health or below they gain Saving Grace for 8 seconds. SAVING GRACE The healing over time portion of your Fluttercall: Restore Life and Fluttercall: Heal is 100% more powerful on allies with Saving Grace. Saving Grace can not be applied more than once every 30 seconds.
Your Fluttercall: Heal has 25% increased healing on targets that have Flutterfly: Restore Life active.
Each tick of Flutterfly Healing has a chance to make your next Nettlebolt cast 3 Nettlebolts at once. Nettlebolt has +20% increased critical strike chance. (2.0 PPM)
The cooldown of your Safe Haven is reduced each time one of your plants wither. Prickly Vine - 1 second Life Petal - 2 seconds Heart Bloom - 3 seconds
While your Blue Flutterfly is following you, you take 5% reduced damage. While your Blue Flutterfly is following another player, they take 5% reduced damage.
Your Ironleaf Ward and Safe Haven abilities shield players for 15 seconds, absorbing up to 1755% intellect damage. Damage dealt to the shield is reduced by 50%.
Your Fluttercall: Heal has 100% faster tick rate for the first 12 seconds each time it begins healing a player.
Your Heart Bloom has 2 charges but only accumulates 8% of all Flutterfly Healing. Heart Bloom gains Cooldown Acceleration equal to your Haste.
Your Enfeebling Rootsap causes the target and all enemies within a 700 radius of the target to have 50% reduced Attack Speed and 50% reduced Movement Speed while active.
The duration of your Fluttercall: Restore Life is increased by 9 seconds.
The first four pulses of Heart Bloom have 50% increased healing.

Each time you generate a Radiant Rune, a free Greater Heal of 20% efficiency is cast on a nearby ally, preferring the player with lowest health. The additional heals triggered by Master of Triage do not trigger Rune of Renewal healing.
When your Circle of Light heals a player, they are healed for an additional 50% of the initial heal over 12 seconds, accumulatively.
Rune of Renewal's healing, Luminous Barrier's absorb, and Soulbrand's damage is increased by 25%.
Your Greater Heal has 0.5 seconds reduced cast time and 20% increased Critical Strike chance.

When an enemy dies while Soulbrand is active on them you instantly gain 50% of the Radiant Rune power it would have generated in the time that was remaining and trigger an explosion dealing 16% of the damage that was remaining to all nearby enemies.
Your Dawnflare casts have a chance to grant you Expansive Mind, increasing your Spirit by 20% for 12 seconds and replenishing 2% max mana every 3 seconds for the duration. (1.2 PPM)
Your Luminous Barrier has 2 charges and gains Cooldown Acceleration equal to your Haste.

Your Circle of Light creates a persistent area on the ground, causing all players standing in it to take 10% reduced damage. After 5 seconds, the area erupts in light, as a second Circle of Light of 50% power heals players in the area.

When you cast Dawnbreaker Orb, and while it is active, each Radiant Rune you spend causes a free Greater Heal of 25% efficiency to be cast on a nearby ally, preferring the player with lowest health. The additional heals triggered by Dawn Strider do not trigger Rune of Renewal healing.
Your Radiant Blast adds 3 seconds to the duration of all your active Rune of Renewal, Soulbrand, and Luminous Barrier effects.
Your Rune of Renewal healing is four times as effective when triggered by your Radiant Blast.
Your Rune of Renewal's initial heal is increased by 100% when healing an ally that already has Rune of Renewal active on them..
Whille Runic Proliferation is active, your Soulbrand, Rune of Renewal, and Luminous Barrier is cast on up to 4 targets at 120% power, as long as you have 2 Radiant Runes to spend.
Your Levitate ability grants you Avatar of Light for 5 seconds.

When your Dawnbreaker Orb heals a player, 50% of that healing is also applied as an absorb shield on that player for 12 seconds. The shield from Meticulous Runesmith stacks up to a maximum absorb value equal to 900% of your Intellect. Damage absorbed by the shield is reduced by 50%.
Every 3 casts of Radiant Blast grants you Divine Light, causing your next Circle of Light to be Free and have 100% increased healing.
Your Soulbrand, Rune of Renewal & Luminous Barrier have 25% increased duration.

Your Dawnflare and Radiant Blast abilities have a 15% chance to grant you Beacon in the Dark, causing your next Radiant Blast to have an additional 50% Critical Strike chance. Upon gaining Beacon in the Dark the cooldown of Radiant Blast is instantly reset.
When your Entropy's Claim expires it erupts, applying Entropic Burst on all enemies near the target, dealing 246% Intellect magic damage over 9 seconds to them. Damage is reduced beyond 5 targets.
Each time your Oblivion deals damage, it deals an additional 20% damage over 12 seconds, accumulatively.
Each time you spend Chrona, you are granted 1 stack of Uchronia. Once you have 3 stacks of Uchronia your next Oblivion, Amend Fate, or Restore Continuity is Free.

Each time you use Chrona you gain 1 stack of Chrona Tap for 9 seconds, up to 10 stacks. Chrona Tap replenishes 1.3% of your Maximum Mana per stack when it expires. The duration is not refreshed when stacks are added.
Your Time Shard has a 25% chance to grant you Quickening, causing your next Flash Revision to be Free, Instant Cast, and it does not apply Stagger.
Your Time Shard reduces the cooldown of Temporal Barrage by 2 seconds when cast toward an enemy with Echoes of Ruin active,
While Unfolding Doom is active on an enemy, your Haste is increased by +20%.
When you are above 50% Chrona you deal 15% more damage with your abilities that do not spend Chrona. When you are below 50% Chrona you generate 25% more Chrona.
Your Fleeting Hour causes all enemies with Echoes of Ruin to languish in ruin, instantly taking damage equal to a full duration of Echoes of Ruin. Damage is reduced beyond 3 targets.
When you cast Fleeting Hour, you gain 30 Chrona.

While channeling Temporal Barrage, each tick grants a benefit to Fleeting Hour. While Fleeting Hour is active, its duration is extended by 0.3 seconds. While Fleeting Hour is on cooldown, its cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds.

When your Deferred Fate: Relay or Deferred Fate: Mass Relay overheals, you gain stacks of Resonant Fate relative to the amount of overhealing. Once you reach 100 stacks of Resonant Fate, your next Amend Fate that removes Stagger on a player also grants that player 12% Damage Reduction for 15 seconds Resonant Fate cannot gain stacks for 20 seconds after it has been consumed.

While Fleeting Hour is active on you, Temporal Barrage is empowered. When targeting an enemy, Temporal Barrage deals 80% more damage to your primary target and causes additional bolts to hit up to 2 enemies near the target for 50% of the power. When targeting an ally, each bolt of Temporal Barrage cleanses the target of 3% Stagger.

Any overhealing done by Oblivion on a player applies a shield to them absorbing 25% of the overhealing amount, stacking up to 15% of their maximum health. Oblivion's Embrace lasts for 8 seconds. Damage absorbed by Oblivion's Embrace is reduced by 50%. Oblivion critical strikes deal 20% more damage.

Your Entropy's Claim deals 25% more damage. When you cast Unfolding Doom, Your next Time Shard, Echoes of Ruin, or Entropy's Claim is enhanced. Time Shard's cast time is doubled and deals 900% more damage, generates 900% increased Chrona, and heals all allies affected by your Aura of Deferred Fate for 100% of the damage dealt. Echoes of Ruin Applies to up to 20 targets. Entropy's Claim Stuns the target while it is active.
Your Entropy's Claim now has Deferred Fate: Mass Relay, causing it to heal up to 4 allies for 50% of any damage it deals.

Each time your Amend Fate or Restore Continuity cleanses Stagger from an ally, they are granted Echoes of Divinity. Echoes of Divinity clears additional Stagger equal to 10% of the target's max health over 4 seconds.
The Healing caused by your Deferred Fate: Relay and Deferred Fate: Mass Relay is increased by 10%.
